user.title: Create Entry
user.description: Monitor a group of entities, or combine existing groups.

group.title: Create Entity Group
group.description: Create a group of entities to monitor for availability.

data_description.entities: Entities to track for availability. These are fully monitored and included in all KPIs and alerts.
data_description.non_essential_entities: Entities that don't affect your group's health score. Visible on the card and counted in totals, but excluded from all KPIs (availability %, offline count, MTBF, MTTR) and never trigger alerts. Use for devices where downtime is acceptable — a TV, a printer, a seasonal device.

combined.title: Create Combined Group
combined.description: Combine multiple groups into one view for automations and dashboards.

data_description.bad_states: Entity states that indicate an entity is offline (e.g., unavailable, unknown).
data_description.cooldown: How long (in seconds) an entity must stay in a bad state before it is marked offline. Prevents false alarms from brief disconnections.
data_description.staleness_threshold: If an entity hasn't changed state for this many minutes, mark it as degraded. This catches entities that report 'available' but have actually stopped sending data. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.staleness_use_last_updated: When on, any update from the entity — including attribute-only changes or repeated same-value reports — resets the staleness timer. When off (default), only a change in the main state counts. Turn on for devices that report often but rarely change value (e.g. temperature or power that holds steady).

data_description.battery_threshold: Flag entities whose battery falls below this percentage. The 'low' state is also automatically detected. Volt-based entities are not supported. Use entities that report battery as a percentage or support the 'low' state.
data_description.signal_enabled: Track signal strength for monitored entities and alert when signal quality drops to 'poor'. Supports dBm-based networks (Wi-Fi, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Bluetooth, etc.) and percentage-based sensors. After enabling, you will be asked to bind a signal sensor and select the network type for each entity.
data_description.availability_windows: Time windows for tracking group availability history (e.g. today, 3d, 7d).
data_description.recovery_window: How long (in minutes) an entity stays in the Recently Offline or Recently Recovered sensors after a state transition.
data_description.use_device_names: Show the HA device name instead of the entity friendly name in offline/recovered sensor states. Falls back to friendly name for entities not linked to a device.
data_description.collapse_devices: Only works when 'Show device names' is enabled. When on, multiple entities that belong to the same physical device are counted as one across every sensor value, list and event (offline, low battery, stale, poor signal). Entities only merge when they share the same device, name, battery level and signal — entities not linked to a device are never merged. Availability %, MTBF and MTTR stay per-entity.

battery_mapping.title: Battery Entity Mapping
battery_mapping.description: Confirm or change the battery sensor for each monitored entity. Leave empty for entities without batteries. Supports numeric (%) and text states ('low').

signal_mapping.title: Signal Strength Mapping
signal_mapping.description:
For each entity, optionally select a signal sensor and choose the network type. Leave the sensor empty to skip.

Thresholds (good / ok / poor):
• 5G: ≥ −80 dBm / ≥ −100 dBm / < −100 dBm
• Bluetooth: ≥ −70 dBm / ≥ −85 dBm / < −85 dBm
• Generic/RSSI: ≥ −60 dBm / ≥ −80 dBm / < −80 dBm
• LoRaWAN: ≥ −100 dBm / ≥ −115 dBm / < −115 dBm
• LTE/4G: ≥ −80 dBm / ≥ −90 dBm / < −90 dBm
• Percentage: ≥ 70% / ≥ 40% / < 40%
• Thread: ≥ −70 dBm / ≥ −85 dBm / < −85 dBm
• Wi-Fi: ≥ −67 dBm / ≥ −70 dBm / < −70 dBm
• Z-Wave: ≥ −70 dBm / ≥ −85 dBm / < −85 dBm
• Zigbee (LQI): ≥ 201 / ≥ 51 / < 51 (higher is better)
• Zigbee (RSSI/dBm): ≥ −70 dBm / ≥ −85 dBm / < −85 dBm

error.no_entities: You must select at least one entity.
error.duplicate_entities: The same entity cannot appear in both lists. Remove duplicates before saving.
error.not_enough_groups_selected: Select at least two groups to combine.
error.collapse_requires_device_names: Collapse entities by device requires Show device names to be enabled.

abort.already_configured: A group with this name already exists.
abort.not_enough_groups: You need at least two groups before creating a combined group.
